title: Sequence-aware latency attribution topology and autoshed visualizer
creator: Asha Menon
description: Add a sequence-aware instrumentation and visualization stack that ties token-level latency anomalies to topology (shard->host->region), KV-cache states, and circuit/capacity signals. Deliver a dashboard (Autoshed Visualizer) that lets SREs and oncall map a tail latency spike to causal signals (cache miss surge, admit-score decline, shard eviction) and view recommended failover/rollback actions.
acceptance_criteria: Schema: token-level SLIs (p50/p95/p99 per token and per-sequence) available in GoldenSignals dataset with tags: region, shard_id, model_variant, admission_score, kv_hit
Dashboard: Autoshed Visualizer shows correlated time-series and a topological view mapping affected tokens to shards and regions with color-coded circuit states
Playbook links: dashboard includes one-click links to the failover runbook and a synthetic-prober dashboard for fast rehearse
Alerting: New SLO-derived alert triggers when rolling 5m p99 token latency delta > 2x baseline and admit_rate drops > 10% concurrently
Performance: instrumentation adds <1% CPU overhead on runtime proxies in canary region at 2x baseline traffic
tasks: Define token SLI schema and sample cardinality (team: telemetry)
Implement lightweight sequence attribution headers in runtime (team: serving-runtime)
Emit KV-cache hit/miss tags and admission_score in request traces (team: serving-runtime)
Build topology service endpoint mapping shard_id -> host -> region (team: infra)
Create Autoshed Visualizer dashboard and reusable panels (team: observability)
Add correlation queries and auto-annotators for suspected causes (team: telemetry + SRE)
Run canary in us-west-2 for 48h and measure overhead and false-positive rate (team: SRE)
Update failover runbook with new decision gates and dashboard snapshots (team: SRE/PM)
design_decisions: Emit token-level timing as sampled spans with fixed reservoir (1 in 50) to bound telemetry volume; provide opt-in higher sampling for Dedicated customers.
Topology lookup will be cached in the observability layer and refreshed every 30s to avoid lookup amplification during incidents.
Autoshed Visualizer will use a hybrid view: time-series correlation panels + force-directed topology map for quick triage.
Admission score will be included as a numeric tag (0..100) to allow thresholding in queries instead of relying on opaque enums.
Circuit state changes (open/half-open/closed) are emitted as events to the GoldenSignals pipeline to ensure they appear on dashboards as annotations.
Avoid changing existing SLI names; introduce new names with suffix _seq_attrib to let downstream alerts opt-in without breaking historical dashboards.
metrics: token_latency_ms_seq_attrib.p50,p95,p99 tagged by region, shard_id, model_variant
admit_score_distribution per customer and per shard (percentiles)
dashboard_panels: Top: p99 token latency heatmap by region and model_variant (5m rollup)
Left: time-series pane with token latency p95, kv_hit_ratio, admit_rate, circuit_state annotations
Center: topology map showing shards colored by current admit_score and recent p99 delta
Bottom: ranked suspected causes list auto-populated by correlation engine (cache misses, admission drops, capacity pressure)
Side: one-click action buttons linking to region failover, circuit rollback, and synthetic replay harness
rollout_plan: Week 1: implement schema + topology endpoint + minimal span emission in canary region (us-west-2)
Week 2: wire GoldenSignals ingestion, basic panels; low-sample dashboard QA with SRE
Week 3: enable correlation heuristics, add annotations for circuit events; run synthetic incident rehearsals
Week 4: widen sampling to other regions, run 48h stability and false-positive analysis; if stable, flip feature flag for 30% of traffic in production
Post-rollout: 2-week monitoring window, collect feedback, then promote to full rollout with Dedicated opt-in docs
